title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - CountryCompanyNumber
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/CountryCompanyNumber. Defines an arbitrary country-specific company number based on (i) an (arbitrary) country-specific numbering scheme identifier and (ii) the corresponding (arbitrary) unique identifier. Subclass of RegistrationNumber per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the RegistrationNumber model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'CountryCompanyNumber'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

countryCompanyNumber.description: Property. The Company Number Identifier of a certain country schema.

companyNumberQualifier.description: Property. The Company Number Schema Qualifier. Within a single country, the Company Number Schema Qualifier has to be unique.

countryCode.description: Property. Unique code identifying a country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or literal string).
